source.title: Connect {provider}
source.description: Credentials stay in Home Assistant. Shared links must be viewable without signing in. Local folders must be in Home Assistant's media directories or allowlist_external_dirs. For a NAS, mount its folder in Home Assistant first. UGREEN uses an experimental API. For Ente, the optional server URL is the Ente API origin, not the web app.

selection.title: Choose photos
selection.description: Combine any albums or people. An empty selection shows the whole library, except UGREEN, which requires at least one album. Immich search uses a JSON object; PhotoPrism search uses its normal query syntax.

existing_icloud.title: Copy existing iCloud connection
existing_icloud.description: Copies the shared-album connection into Minimal Slideshow. The original integration is unchanged; Minimal runs independently after copying.

error.invalid_path: Choose an existing folder allowed by Home Assistant. Add it to media_dirs or allowlist_external_dirs first.
error.no_photos: No supported photos were found. Check the selected source and account permissions.
error.invalid_search: Enter a valid JSON object for the Immich search.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, credentials, permissions and TLS certificate.
error.otp_required: This account needs a current two-factor code. Enter it below.

abort.no_existing_source: No existing iCloud source was found.
